records.context: Statistical conventions
records.label: spacr.agreement#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Statistical conventions
records.translation: Convenciones estadísticas

records.context: **κ has no value when there is no variance.** κ = (pₒ − pₑ)/(1 − pₑ). If both annotators put every compared row in the same single class, pₑ = 1 and the denominator vanishes: the answer is *undefined*, not 1.0. If just one annotator used a single class, pₑ collapses onto the other's marginal and κ is identically 0 no matter how well they agree. Both cases return ``nan`` with an explanation attached, because on a screen where 98 % of cells are negative they are the *normal* case, and a returned 0.0 or 1.0 there would misstate the agreement.
records.label: spacr.agreement#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **κ has no value when there is no variance.** κ = (pₒ − pₑ)/(1 − pₑ). If both annotators put every compared row in the same single class, pₑ = 1 and the denominator vanishes: the answer is *undefined*, not 1.0. If just one annotator used a single class, pₑ collapses onto the other's marginal and κ is identically 0 no matter how well they agree. Both cases return ``nan`` with an explanation attached, because on a screen where 98 % of cells are negative they are the *normal* case, and a returned 0.0 or 1.0 there would misstate the agreement.
records.translation: **κ no tiene valor cuando no hay varianza.** κ = (pₒ − pₑ)/(1 − pₑ). Si ambos anotadores asignan todas las filas comparadas a una misma clase única, pₑ = 1 y el denominador se anula: la respuesta es *indefinida*, no 1.0. Si solo uno de los anotadores usó una única clase, pₑ se reduce a la marginal del otro y κ es idénticamente 0 por mucho que coincidan. Ambos casos devuelven ``nan`` con una explicación adjunta, porque en un cribado en el que el 98 % de las células son negativas son el caso *normal*, y devolver 0.0 o 1.0 en ellos daría una imagen errónea de la concordancia.

records.context: **Raw agreement is reported next to κ, always.** 95 % agreement with κ ≈ 0 is the prevalence paradox (Feinstein & Cicchetti, 1990), not a broken annotator: when one class dominates, chance agreement is already almost as high as the observed agreement, so κ has almost no room left.
records.label: spacr.agreement#8
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Raw agreement is reported next to κ, always.** 95 % agreement with κ ≈ 0 is the prevalence paradox (Feinstein & Cicchetti, 1990), not a broken annotator: when one class dominates, chance agreement is already almost as high as the observed agreement, so κ has almost no room left.
records.translation: **La concordancia bruta se notifica junto a κ, siempre.** Una concordancia del 95 % con κ ≈ 0 es la paradoja de la prevalencia (Feinstein & Cicchetti, 1990), no un anotador defectuoso: cuando una clase domina, la concordancia por azar ya es casi tan alta como la observada, por lo que a κ apenas le queda margen.

records.context: **The interpretation bands are a convention.** Landis & Koch (1977) "slight/fair/moderate/substantial/almost perfect" is a rule of thumb with no distributional basis. It is reported as a label, and labelled as a convention.
records.label: spacr.agreement#9
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The interpretation bands are a convention.** Landis & Koch (1977) "slight/fair/moderate/substantial/almost perfect" is a rule of thumb with no distributional basis. It is reported as a label, and labelled as a convention.
records.translation: **Las franjas de interpretación son una convención.** Las de Landis & Koch (1977), "slight/fair/moderate/substantial/almost perfect", son una regla práctica sin base distribucional. Se notifican como etiqueta, y etiquetadas como convención.

records.context: Model-written columns are excluded. A machine-learning classification model writes into this same table — ``pred``/``cv_predictions`` from the CV stage, ``predictions``/``ml_pred`` from the ML one — and its class column is indistinguishable *by shape* from an annotation pass. Offering it made ``agreement_report`` score the machine-learning classification model as a third annotator, which is a different question with the same units: on a real database, four "annotators" gave κ = -0.004 where the two humans agree at 0.471. See :data:`_MODEL_COLUMNS`.
records.label: spacr.agreement.annotation_columns#2

A classifier writes into this same table — ``pred``/``cv_predictions`` from the CV stage, ``predictions``/``ml_pred`` from the ML one — and its class column is indistinguishable *by shape* from an annotation pass. Offering it made ``agreement_report`` score the classifier as a third annotator, which is a different question with the same units: on a real database, four "annotators" gave κ = -0.004 where the two humans agree at 0.471. See :data:`_MODEL_COLUMNS`.
records.translation: Se excluyen las columnas escritas por modelos. Un clasificador escribe en esta misma tabla (``pred``/``cv_predictions`` desde la etapa CV, ``predictions``/``ml_pred`` desde la de ML), y su columna de clases es indistinguible *por su forma* de una pasada de anotación. Ofrecerla hacía que ``agreement_report`` puntuara al clasificador como un tercer anotador, que es otra pregunta con las mismas unidades: en una base de datos real, cuatro "annotators" dieron κ = -0.004 cuando los dos humanos coinciden en 0.471. Véase :data:`_MODEL_COLUMNS`.

records.context: Map Barcodes has to be told three things it cannot guess: which mate carries each barcode, whether the reference table is stored in the same orientation as the reads, and where in the read the barcode sits.  Getting any of them wrong produces a processing session that finishes normally and maps nothing, because every stage after the extraction window is working on the wrong bases.  This module reads a bounded sample of the reads, measures each reference table against them in both orientations, and turns the measurements into settings the mapping run can use. It holds no graphical code and opens no dialogs, so the same engine serves the live search in the interface, a notebook, and the tests.

Getting any of them wrong produces a run that finishes normally and maps nothing, because every stage after the extraction window is working on the wrong bases.  This module reads a bounded sample of the reads, measures each reference table against them in both orientations, and turns the measurements into settings the mapping run can use. It holds no graphical code and opens no dialogs, so the same engine serves the live search in the interface, a notebook, and the tests.
records.translation: A Map Barcodes hay que indicarle tres cosas que no puede adivinar: qué lectura del par lleva cada código de barras, si la tabla de referencia está almacenada en la misma orientación que las lecturas y en qué lugar de la lectura se encuentra el código de barras.  Equivocarse en cualquiera de ellas produce una ejecución que termina con normalidad y no asigna nada, porque todas las etapas posteriores a la ventana de extracción trabajan sobre las bases equivocadas.  Este módulo lee una muestra acotada de las lecturas, mide cada tabla de referencia frente a ellas en ambas orientaciones y convierte las mediciones en una configuración que la ejecución de asignación puede usar. No contiene código gráfico ni abre cuadros de diálogo, de modo que el mismo motor sirve a la búsqueda en vivo de la interfaz, a un cuaderno y a las pruebas.

records.context: Chance matches
records.label: spacr.barcode_search#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Chance matches
records.translation: Coincidencias por azar

records.context: A short barcode turns up in a long read by pure coincidence.  Thirty-two distinct eight base barcodes scanned across a hundred and fifty base read have about a seven percent chance of a spurious match, so a table that is genuinely absent still reports roughly seven percent of reads as hits.  Reporting that rate as a finding would misidentify the table as present and could configure a mapping that yields nothing.  Every rate this module reports therefore arrives with the rate expected by chance for that table against those reads, and with the ratio between them.  Nothing is called present unless it stands well clear of its own coincidence rate.
records.label: spacr.barcode_search#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A short barcode turns up in a long read by pure coincidence.  Thirty-two distinct eight base barcodes scanned across a hundred and fifty base read have about a seven percent chance of a spurious match, so a table that is genuinely absent still reports roughly seven percent of reads as hits.  Reporting that rate as a finding would misidentify the table as present and could configure a mapping that yields nothing.  Every rate this module reports therefore arrives with the rate expected by chance for that table against those reads, and with the ratio between them.  Nothing is called present unless it stands well clear of its own coincidence rate.
records.translation: Un código de barras corto aparece en una lectura larga por pura coincidencia.  Treinta y dos códigos de barras distintos de ocho bases rastreados a lo largo de una lectura de ciento cincuenta bases tienen aproximadamente un siete por ciento de probabilidad de una coincidencia espuria, de modo que una tabla que realmente está ausente sigue notificando como aciertos aproximadamente el siete por ciento de las lecturas.  Notificar esa tasa como hallazgo identificaría erróneamente la tabla como presente y podría configurar una asignación que no produce nada.  Por ello, cada tasa que notifica este módulo va acompañada de la tasa esperada por azar para esa tabla frente a esas lecturas, y del cociente entre ambas.  Nada se declara presente salvo que se sitúe claramente por encima de su propia tasa de coincidencia por azar.

records.context: Match position
records.label: spacr.barcode_search#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Match position
records.translation: Posición de la coincidencia

records.context: Enrichment over chance answers whether the sequences are in the reads.  It does not answer whether they are the laboratory microplate barcodes.  Sequencing adapters are fixed sequences repeated in every read, and a handful of barcodes in any table will resemble part of an adapter closely enough to match it.  That produces a large, perfectly real enrichment driven by two barcodes sitting in the adapter rather than by a laboratory microplate.  The measurement that separates the two is position.  A laboratory microplate barcode occupies one place in the construct and so lands at one offset in almost every read, which is exactly why an extraction window can be proposed for it at all.  A match scattered across the read cannot yield a window and is not treated as a finding, however enriched it is.
records.label: spacr.barcode_search#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Enrichment over chance answers whether the sequences are in the reads.  It does not answer whether they are the plate barcodes.  Sequencing adapters are fixed sequences repeated in every read, and a handful of barcodes in any table will resemble part of an adapter closely enough to match it.  That produces a large, perfectly real enrichment driven by two barcodes sitting in the adapter rather than by a plate.  The measurement that separates the two is position.  A plate barcode occupies one place in the construct and so lands at one offset in almost every read, which is exactly why an extraction window can be proposed for it at all.  A match scattered across the read cannot yield a window and is not treated as a finding, however enriched it is.
records.translation: El enriquecimiento sobre el azar responde a si las secuencias están en las lecturas.  No responde a si son los códigos de barras de la placa.  Los adaptadores de secuenciación son secuencias fijas que se repiten en todas las lecturas, y un puñado de códigos de barras de cualquier tabla se parecerá a una parte de un adaptador lo suficiente como para coincidir con él.  Eso produce un enriquecimiento grande y perfectamente real impulsado por dos códigos de barras que se encuentran en el adaptador y no por una placa.  La medida que separa ambos casos es la posición.  Un código de barras de la placa ocupa un único lugar en la construcción y, por tanto, aparece en el mismo desplazamiento en casi todas las lecturas, que es precisamente la razón por la que se le puede proponer una ventana de extracción.  Una coincidencia dispersa a lo largo de la lectura no puede dar lugar a una ventana y no se trata como hallazgo, por enriquecida que esté.

records.context: A report carrying one finding per combination of reference table, orientation and input file.  Each finding holds the observed rate, the chance rate, the enrichment, the offset distribution, the narrowest offset window that accounts for most of the hits, how many distinct barcodes of the table were seen, and a verdict with a sentence saying why that verdict was reached.  The report can be rendered as a table for a log, and it can be folded into the settings that :func:`spacr.sequencing.generate_barecode_mapping` reads.

Cada hallazgo contiene la tasa observada, la tasa por azar, el enriquecimiento, la distribución de desplazamientos, la ventana de desplazamientos más estrecha que explica la mayoría de los aciertos, cuántos códigos de barras distintos de la tabla se observaron y un veredicto con una frase que explica por qué se llegó a él. records.translation: Una tabla que no es de nucleótidos genera una excepción en lugar de invertirse. records.context: A read is treated as a run of independent bases drawn evenly from the four of them, so one barcode of a given length matches at one position with a probability of one over four raised to that length, and a read offers one more position than the difference between its length and the barcode's. The probability that no barcode of the table matches anywhere is the product over every barcode and every position of the probability that it does not match there, and the answer is one minus that product.  Reads of different lengths are averaged.

records.source: A read is treated as a run of independent bases drawn evenly from the four of them, so one barcode of a given length matches at one position with a probability of one over four raised to that length, and a read offers one more position than the difference between its length and the barcode's. The probability that no barcode of the table matches anywhere is the product over every barcode and every position of the probability that it does not match there, and the answer is one minus that product.  Reads of different lengths are averaged.
records.translation: Una lectura se trata como una sucesión de bases independientes extraídas por igual de las cuatro, de modo que un código de barras de una longitud dada coincide en una posición con una probabilidad de uno entre cuatro elevado a esa longitud, y una lectura ofrece una posición más que la diferencia entre su longitud y la del código de barras. La probabilidad de que ningún código de barras de la tabla coincida en ninguna parte es el producto, sobre todos los códigos de barras y todas las posiciones, de la probabilidad de que no coincida allí, y la respuesta es uno menos ese producto.  Las lecturas de distintas longitudes se promedian.

records.context: The even base assumption is the weak point and it was checked rather than assumed.  On a real run the tables that were genuinely absent matched within two tenths of a percentage point of the rate this returns, which is close enough for the ratio between observed and expected to be trusted.

records.source: **Mask correction.** Cellpose can merge two touching cells or clip a lobe. :class:`MaskCuration` paints corrections into the labels with a brush, instead of re-running segmentation or discarding the field.
records.translation: **Corrección de máscaras.** Cellpose puede fusionar dos células que se tocan o recortar un lóbulo. :class:`MaskCuration` pinta las correcciones en las etiquetas con un pincel, en lugar de volver a ejecutar la segmentación o descartar el campo de imagen.

records.context: **A corrected dataset must be distinguishable from a raw one.** A hand-edited mask is otherwise indistinguishable from a segmented one, and it is later impossible to say which microscope fields of view were edited, by whom, or what they looked like before. Every correction here therefore goes through :class:`CurationLog`: an append-only ledger, written beside the artefact it describes, recording what changed, when, and to what. Every correction made through the supported edit methods leaves an entry. The public layer and table objects remain accessible to views and advanced callers; mutating those objects directly bypasses this provenance guarantee.
records.label: spacr.curation#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **A corrected dataset must be distinguishable from a raw one.** A hand-edited mask is otherwise indistinguishable from a segmented one, and it is later impossible to say which fields were edited, by whom, or what they looked like before. Every correction here therefore goes through :class:`CurationLog`: an append-only ledger, written beside the artefact it describes, recording what changed, when, and to what. Every correction made through the supported edit methods leaves an entry. The public layer and table objects remain accessible to views and advanced callers; mutating those objects directly bypasses this provenance guarantee.
records.translation: **Un conjunto de datos corregido debe poder distinguirse de uno en bruto.** De lo contrario, una máscara editada a mano es indistinguible de una segmentada, y más tarde es imposible decir qué campos se editaron, quién lo hizo o qué aspecto tenían antes. Por ello, cada corrección aquí pasa por :class:`CurationLog`: un registro de solo adición, escrito junto al artefacto que describe, que anota qué cambió, cuándo y a qué. Cada corrección hecha mediante los métodos de edición admitidos deja una entrada. Los objetos públicos de capa y de tabla siguen siendo accesibles para las vistas y para usos avanzados; modificar esos objetos directamente elude esta garantía de procedencia.

records.context: What the ledger is, and is not
records.label: spacr.curation#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: What the ledger is, and is not
records.translation: Qué es el registro, y qué no es

records.context: It is a *provenance* record, not an undo file. :meth:`MaskCuration.undo` works off an in-memory history of exact pixel values and is bounded; the ledger keeps one small JSON entry per action forever. Making one serve both would mean either a ledger big enough to hold every painted voxel or an undo stack that silently forgot.
records.label: spacr.curation#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: It is a *provenance* record, not an undo file. :meth:`MaskCuration.undo` works off an in-memory history of exact pixel values and is bounded; the ledger keeps one small JSON entry per action forever. Making one serve both would mean either a ledger big enough to hold every painted voxel or an undo stack that silently forgot.
records.translation: Es un registro de *procedencia*, no un archivo de deshacer. :meth:`MaskCuration.undo` trabaja con un historial en memoria de valores de píxel exactos y está acotado; el registro conserva para siempre una pequeña entrada JSON por acción. Hacer que uno sirviera para ambas cosas significaría o bien un registro lo bastante grande para contener cada vóxel pintado o bien una pila de deshacer que olvidara en silencio.

records.context: It is deliberately a sidecar rather than a table in ``measurements.db``. Mask and track curation happen on a folder of TIFFs long before (and often without) a measurement database, and a provenance record that only exists once you have measured is a record that misses the edits most worth having.
records.label: spacr.curation#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: It is deliberately a sidecar rather than a table in ``measurements.db``. Mask and track curation happen on a folder of TIFFs long before (and often without) a measurement database, and a provenance record that only exists once you have measured is a record that misses the edits most worth having.
records.translation: Es deliberadamente un archivo adjunto y no una tabla de ``measurements.db``. La selección de máscaras y de trayectorias se hace sobre una carpeta de TIFFs mucho antes de (y a menudo sin) una base de datos de mediciones, y un registro de procedencia que solo existe una vez que se ha medido es un registro que pierde las ediciones que más interesa conservar.

records.context: a single entry out of a ledger's ``edits`` list. Every structured-data name is optional, so an entry written by an older version — or one hand-trimmed in the JSON — loads instead of taking the whole ledger down with it. A missing structured-data name becomes an empty value whatever the field declares: ``""`` for ``kind``, ``when`` and ``who``, ``None`` for ``target``, ``0`` for ``n_changed``, ``{}`` for ``detail``. A missing ``when`` is therefore ``""`` and not the current time, so a reconstructed edit never claims a timestamp it does not have. Structured-data names this class does not know are dropped; put anything you want kept under ``detail``.

records.source: a single entry out of a ledger's ``edits`` list. Every key is optional, so an entry written by an older version — or one hand-trimmed in the JSON — loads instead of taking the whole ledger down with it. A missing key becomes an empty value whatever the field declares: ``""`` for ``kind``, ``when`` and ``who``, ``None`` for ``target``, ``0`` for ``n_changed``, ``{}`` for ``detail``. A missing ``when`` is therefore ``""`` and not the current time, so a reconstructed edit never claims a timestamp it does not have. Keys this class does not know are dropped; put anything you want kept under ``detail``.
records.translation: una única entrada de la lista ``edits`` de un registro. Todas las claves son opcionales, de modo que una entrada escrita por una versión anterior, o recortada a mano en el JSON, se carga en lugar de arrastrar consigo todo el registro. Una clave ausente pasa a ser un valor vacío sea cual sea lo que declare el campo: ``""`` para ``kind``, ``when`` y ``who``, ``None`` para ``target``, ``0`` para ``n_changed``, ``{}`` para ``detail``. Por tanto, un ``when`` ausente es ``""`` y no la hora actual, de modo que una edición reconstruida nunca declara una marca de tiempo que no tiene. Las claves que esta clase no conoce se descartan; ponga bajo ``detail`` todo lo que quiera conservar.

records.context: The pixels and the record are written by one call, because either one alone misrepresents the file. They are two sequential filesystem writes, not an atomic transaction; if a process stops between them, call this method again to bring the ledger back in step. A ledger written on its own asserts corrections to a file whose pixels are untouched, and :func:`is_curated` then reports that untouched file as hand-edited; labels written on their own are a curated mask that is byte-indistinguishable from a segmented one.

records.source: The pixels and the record are written by one call, because either one alone misrepresents the file. They are two sequential filesystem writes, not an atomic transaction; if a process stops between them, call this method again to bring the ledger back in step. A ledger written on its own asserts corrections to a file whose pixels are untouched, and :func:`is_curated` then reports that untouched file as hand-edited; labels written on their own are a curated mask that is byte-indistinguishable from a segmented one.
records.translation: Los píxeles y el registro se escriben con una sola llamada, porque cualquiera de los dos por sí solo representa erróneamente el archivo. Son dos escrituras secuenciales en el sistema de archivos, no una transacción atómica; si un proceso se detiene entre ambas, vuelva a llamar a este método para resincronizar el registro. Un registro escrito por sí solo afirma correcciones de un archivo cuyos píxeles no se han tocado, y :func:`is_curated` notifica entonces ese archivo intacto como editado a mano; unas etiquetas escritas por sí solas son una máscara corregida indistinguible byte a byte de una segmentada.

records.translation: El punto de conexión a partir del cual se actualiza un panel. Es distinto de suscribirse a la *capa*, que se activa una vez por toque: un trazo son muchos toques y una sola entrada del registro, y una vista que quiere mostrar la entrada tiene que enterarse de la entrada.

records.context: called as ``fn(edit)`` with the :class:`CurationEdit` just appended, synchronously, on whichever thread made the edit. Pass a bound method: registration is de-duplicated by equality, and a bound method looked up fresh compares equal to the one already held, so ``subscribe`` twice is a no-op and :meth:`unsubscribe` works — where each fresh lambda is a new object that stacks up and cannot be removed, besides keeping a closed panel alive as a receiver. An exception thrown inside ``fn`` is swallowed: the correction has already happened to the data, and one view's failed redraw must not be reported as a failed edit.
records.label: spacr.curation.MaskCuration.subscribe#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: called as ``fn(edit)`` with the :class:`CurationEdit` just appended, synchronously, on whichever thread made the edit. Pass a bound method: registration is de-duplicated by equality, and a bound method looked up fresh compares equal to the one already held, so ``subscribe`` twice is a no-op and :meth:`unsubscribe` works — where each fresh lambda is a new object that stacks up and cannot be removed, besides keeping a closed panel alive as a receiver. An exception raised inside ``fn`` is swallowed: the correction has already happened to the data, and one view's failed redraw must not be reported as a failed edit.
records.translation: se llama como ``fn(edit)`` con el :class:`CurationEdit` recién añadido, de forma síncrona, en el hilo que haya hecho la edición. Pase un método vinculado: el registro elimina duplicados por igualdad, y un método vinculado obtenido de nuevo es igual al que ya está registrado, de modo que llamar dos veces a ``subscribe`` no tiene efecto y :meth:`unsubscribe` funciona, mientras que cada lambda nueva es un objeto nuevo que se acumula y no puede eliminarse, además de mantener vivo como receptor un panel cerrado. Una excepción generada dentro de ``fn`` se descarta: la corrección ya se ha aplicado a los datos, y el redibujado fallido de una vista no debe notificarse como una edición fallida.

records.context: **Why a separate table.** The columns could be added to ``cell``, but a data-selection boundary is not a measurement: it is an interpretation, it is re-drawn often, and it belongs to whichever object the user was looking at. That is why nothing merges on the result of this function without putting it through :func:`require_full_identity` first -- an object label is unique only WITHIN a field, so merging on it alone collides objects across plates, wells and fields. Por eso nada se fusiona con el resultado de esta función sin pasarlo antes por :func:`require_full_identity`: una etiqueta de objeto solo es única WITHIN de un campo, de modo que fusionar solo por ella hace colisionar objetos de distintas placas, pocillos y campos. records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Metadata joins are validated as many-to-one. Repeated transcript records are collapsed before the join so they cannot duplicate a gene in the hit list. Backends without frequentist p-values are ranked by bootstrap selection frequency; other supported backends are ranked by q-value.
records.translation: Las uniones de metadatos se validan como de muchos a uno. Los registros de transcritos repetidos se reducen antes de la unión para que no puedan duplicar un gen en la lista de aciertos. Los motores sin p-values frecuentistas se ordenan por frecuencia de selección bootstrap; los demás motores admitidos se ordenan por q-value.

records.source: Matching predicted objects to labelled ones
records.translation: Emparejamiento de los objetos predichos con los etiquetados

records.context: Matching is one-to-one and optimal, not greedy. A greedy pass down the IoU matrix is cheaper and gives a different answer when one prediction overlaps two truths: it takes the first pair it sees rather than the assignment that maximises total overlap, so the score depends on label ORDER, which is an implementation detail of whoever wrote the mask. :func:`match_objects` uses ``scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment``, so relabelling either mask cannot change the result.
records.label: spacr.scorecard#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Matching is one-to-one and optimal, not greedy. A greedy pass down the IoU matrix is cheaper and gives a different answer when one prediction overlaps two truths: it takes the first pair it sees rather than the assignment that maximises total overlap, so the score depends on label ORDER, which is an implementation detail of whoever wrote the mask. :func:`match_objects` uses ``scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment``, so relabelling either mask cannot change the result.
records.translation: El emparejamiento es uno a uno y óptimo, no voraz. Una pasada voraz por la matriz de IoU es más barata y da una respuesta distinta cuando una predicción se solapa con dos objetos de referencia: toma el primer par que ve en lugar de la asignación que maximiza el solapamiento total, de modo que la puntuación depende del ORDER de las etiquetas, que es un detalle de implementación de quien escribió la máscara. :func:`match_objects` usa ``scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment``, de modo que reetiquetar cualquiera de las máscaras no puede cambiar el resultado.

records.context: Pooled from the counts, not averaged from the ratios. A field with three objects and a field with three hundred are not equal evidence, and a mean of per-field precisions treats them as though they were -- so a model that fails on one sparse field is punished as hard as one that fails on a confluent one. Precision, recall and F1 are recomputed from the summed true and false positives; only the per-object means (IoU, Dice, area error) are averaged, weighted by each field's matched-object count.
records.label: spacr.scorecard.score_holdout#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Pooled from the counts, not averaged from the ratios. A field with three objects and a field with three hundred are not equal evidence, and a mean of per-field precisions treats them as though they were -- so a model that fails on one sparse field is punished as hard as one that fails on a confluent one. Precision, recall and F1 are recomputed from the summed true and false positives; only the per-object means (IoU, Dice, area error) are averaged, weighted by each field's matched-object count.
records.translation: Agrupado a partir de los recuentos, no promediado a partir de los cocientes. Un campo con tres objetos y uno con trescientos no son pruebas equivalentes, y una media de precisiones por campo los trata como si lo fueran, de modo que un modelo que falla en un campo poco poblado se penaliza tanto como uno que falla en un campo confluente. La precisión, la exhaustividad y F1 se recalculan a partir de los verdaderos y falsos positivos sumados; solo las medias por objeto (IoU, Dice, error de área) se promedian, ponderadas por el número de objetos emparejados de cada campo.

records.context: Purpose
records.label: spacr.train_compare#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Purpose
records.translation: Propósito

records.context: **k-fold runs keep their folds.** ``folds='per_fold'`` (the default) draws every fold; ``folds='mean'`` draws the fold mean with a ±1 sd band and labels it ``mean of k folds ±sd``; ``folds='both'`` draws both. A mean curve rendered as if it were a single run hides precisely the fold-to-fold variance k-fold was added to expose — and because folds can stop at different epochs (early stopping), the mean carries an ``n_folds`` column so a tail computed from two of five folds is visible rather than implied.
records.label: spacr.train_compare#11
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **k-fold runs keep their folds.** ``folds='per_fold'`` (the default) draws every fold; ``folds='mean'`` draws the fold mean with a ±1 sd band and labels it ``mean of k folds ±sd``; ``folds='both'`` draws both. A mean curve rendered as if it were a single run hides precisely the fold-to-fold variance k-fold was added to expose — and because folds can stop at different epochs (early stopping), the mean carries an ``n_folds`` column so a tail computed from two of five folds is visible rather than implied.
records.translation: **Las ejecuciones k-fold conservan sus pliegues.** ``folds='per_fold'`` (el valor por defecto) dibuja todos los pliegues; ``folds='mean'`` dibuja la media de los pliegues con una banda de ±1 sd y la etiqueta como ``mean of k folds ±sd``; ``folds='both'`` dibuja ambos. Una curva media presentada como si fuera una sola ejecución oculta precisamente la varianza entre pliegues que el k-fold se añadió para mostrar, y como los pliegues pueden detenerse en épocas distintas (parada temprana), la media lleva una columna ``n_folds`` para que una cola calculada a partir de dos de cinco pliegues sea visible en lugar de quedar implícita.

records.context: **Best-epoch and last-epoch are both reported, always.** The best epoch of a validation curve is chosen *using* that curve, so it is an optimistically biased estimate of held-out performance; the last epoch is unbiased but may be well past the optimum.
records.label: spacr.train_compare#12
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Best-epoch and last-epoch are both reported, always.** The best epoch of a validation curve is chosen *using* that curve, so it is an optimistically biased estimate of held-out performance; the last epoch is unbiased but may be well past the optimum.
records.translation: **Siempre se notifican tanto la mejor época como la última.** La mejor época de una curva de validación se elige *usando* esa curva, por lo que es una estimación con sesgo optimista del rendimiento en datos reservados; la última época no tiene sesgo, pero puede estar muy por encima del óptimo.

So this module reuses :func:`spacr.run_journal.values_equal` (structural comparison, so ``"[0, 1, 2]"`` from a CSV round-trip equals ``[0, 1, 2]``) and the same three buckets:
records.label: spacr.train_compare#13
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The settings diff reuses the provenance bucketing.** A flat key-by-key diff of two real runs reports ~200 differences, of which none are decisions anybody made. So this module reuses :func:`spacr.run_journal.values_equal` (structural comparison, so ``"[0, 1, 2]"`` from a CSV round-trip equals ``[0, 1, 2]``) and the same three buckets:
records.translation: **La diferencia de configuración reutiliza la agrupación en categorías de la procedencia.** Una diferencia plana clave a clave de dos ejecuciones reales notifica ~200 diferencias, ninguna de las cuales es una decisión que alguien tomara. Por ello, este módulo reutiliza :func:`spacr.run_journal.values_equal` (comparación estructural, de modo que ``"[0, 1, 2]"`` tras un paso por CSV es igual a ``[0, 1, 2]``) y las mismas tres categorías:

records.context: ``changed`` structured-data names present in *every* run whose values differ — the knobs someone turned. ``env`` environment / non-substantive drift: paths, timestamps, host, versions, worker counts, verbosity. Shown, never mixed into ``changed``. ``drift`` structured-data names absent from at least one processing session — schema drift between spaCR releases, summarised rather than enumerated.

records.source: ``changed`` keys present in *every* run whose values differ — the knobs someone turned. ``env`` environment / non-substantive drift: paths, timestamps, host, versions, worker counts, verbosity. Shown, never mixed into ``changed``. ``drift`` keys absent from at least one run — schema drift between spaCR releases, summarised rather than enumerated.
records.translation: ``changed`` claves presentes en *todas* las ejecuciones cuyos valores difieren: los parámetros que alguien cambió. ``env`` deriva del entorno o no sustantiva: rutas, marcas de tiempo, host, versiones, número de procesos de trabajo, verbosidad. Se muestra, nunca se mezcla con ``changed``. ``drift`` claves ausentes de al menos una ejecución: deriva del esquema entre versiones de spaCR, resumida en lugar de enumerada.

records.context: The settings that produced a processing session are *not* in the processing-session folder: ``save_settings`` writes them to ``<src>/settings/train_test_<model_type>_<epochs>.csv`` as a ``Key,Value`` CSV. :func:`load_run` walks up from the processing-session folder to find it — but only as far as the processing session's own project root, which the layout above makes identifiable: ``<src>`` is the folder the ``model/`` tree hangs off. An ancestor above that belongs to a different project, and reading it would report somebody else's settings as this processing session's provenance, so the settings diff would show differences nobody configured and the answer would depend on where in the filesystem the project happened to sit. See :func:`_owns_this_run`.

records.source: The settings that produced a run are *not* in the run folder: ``save_settings`` writes them to ``<src>/settings/train_test_<model_type>_<epochs>.csv`` as a ``Key,Value`` CSV. :func:`load_run` walks up from the run folder to find it — but only as far as the run's own project root, which the layout above makes identifiable: ``<src>`` is the folder the ``model/`` tree hangs off. An ancestor above that belongs to a different project, and reading it would report somebody else's settings as this run's provenance, so the settings diff would show differences nobody configured and the answer would depend on where in the filesystem the project happened to sit. See :func:`_owns_this_run`.
records.translation: La configuración que produjo una ejecución *no* está en la carpeta de la ejecución: ``save_settings`` la escribe en ``<src>/settings/train_test_<model_type>_<epochs>.csv`` como un CSV ``Key,Value``. :func:`load_run` asciende desde la carpeta de la ejecución para encontrarla, pero solo hasta la raíz del proyecto propia de la ejecución, que la estructura anterior hace identificable: ``<src>`` es la carpeta de la que cuelga el árbol ``model/``. Un ancestro por encima pertenece a otro proyecto, y leerlo notificaría la configuración de otra persona como procedencia de esta ejecución, de modo que la diferencia de configuración mostraría diferencias que nadie configuró y la respuesta dependería de dónde estuviera situado el proyecto en el sistema de archivos. Véase :func:`_owns_this_run`.

records.context: ``run_ids`` the runs that contributed settings, in order. ``changed`` ``[{'key', 'values': {run_id: value}}]`` for structured-data names present in every contributing run whose values differ — the signal. ``env`` same shape, for structured-data names :func:`is_env_key` classifies as environment drift. Never merged into ``changed``. ``drift`` ``[{'key', 'present': [...], 'missing': [...]}]`` — schema drift. ``same`` / ``shared`` counts of unchanged and shared structured-data names. ``identical`` True when two or more runs contributed settings and nothing at all differs. Callers must say "no differences" rather than render an empty table. ``no_settings`` processing-session ids that had no settings to contribute. ``env_manifest`` the manifest ``env`` diff, when the folders are processing-session journal folders.
records.label: spacr.train_compare.diff_settings#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: ``run_ids`` the runs that contributed settings, in order. ``changed`` ``[{'key', 'values': {run_id: value}}]`` for keys present in every contributing run whose values differ — the signal. ``env`` same shape, for keys :func:`is_env_key` classifies as environment drift. Never merged into ``changed``. ``drift`` ``[{'key', 'present': [...], 'missing': [...]}]`` — schema drift. ``same`` / ``shared`` counts of unchanged and shared keys. ``identical`` True when two or more runs contributed settings and nothing at all differs. Callers must say "no differences" rather than render an empty table. ``no_settings`` run ids that had no settings to contribute. ``env_manifest`` the manifest ``env`` diff, when the folders are run-journal runs.
records.translation: ``run_ids`` las ejecuciones que aportaron configuración, en orden. ``changed`` ``[{'key', 'values': {run_id: value}}]`` para las claves presentes en todas las ejecuciones que aportaron configuración y cuyos valores difieren: la señal. ``env`` misma forma, para las claves que :func:`is_env_key` clasifica como deriva del entorno. Nunca se fusiona con ``changed``. ``drift`` ``[{'key', 'present': [...], 'missing': [...]}]``: deriva del esquema. ``same`` / ``shared`` recuentos de claves sin cambios y compartidas. ``identical`` True cuando dos o más ejecuciones aportaron configuración y no difiere absolutamente nada. Quien llama debe decir "no differences" en lugar de presentar una tabla vacía. ``no_settings`` identificadores de las ejecuciones que no tenían configuración que aportar. ``env_manifest`` la diferencia ``env`` del manifiesto, cuando las carpetas son ejecuciones del diario de ejecución.
